sources: MNE-Python OPM sample dataset (mne.datasets.opm), file MEG/OPM/OPM_SEF_raw.fif
meta.licence: no licence stated (MNE dataset docs; the OSF host project 'MNE' has no licence set)
meta.credited: dataset added to MNE 0.17 by Rasmus Zetter and Eric Larson (MNE changelog); recording lab not stated
meta.label: Recorded on Earth with real QuSpin OPM sensors. Not an astronaut.
meta.sensors: nine QuSpin SERF OPMs over the right somatomotor area; electrical median-nerve stimulation at the left wrist (MNE example text)
meta.processing: filtered as in the MNE-Python example 'Optically pumped magnetometer (OPM) data' (examples/datasets/opm_data.py): low-pass 90 Hz (10 Hz transition), 50 Hz notch, median-nerve trigger 257 on STI101, epochs -0.5 to 1 s, reject mag 2e-10 T; first 60 s; first 8 of the 9 OPM channels; decimated 1000 -> 250 Hz after the 90 Hz low-pass; T converted to fT

evoked.note: average of the stimulus-locked epochs that passed rejection, processed as in the MNE-Python example 'Optically pumped magnetometer (OPM) data' (examples/datasets/opm_data.py): low-pass 90 Hz (10 Hz transition), 50 Hz notch, median-nerve trigger 257 on STI101, epochs -0.5 to 1 s, reject mag 2e-10 T; baseline -0.5 to 0 s; calculated from the recording itself
